versions.changelog:
ui-master v1.0.1

- Added new example components: ai-chat-components.tsx, header.tsx, and sidebar.tsx, expanding practical reference coverage for modern UI patterns.
- Introduced references/modern-effects.md with advanced effects and Tailwind v4 usage tips.
- Updated documentation to reference new examples and a dedicated section ("Step 4b — Modern effects") for modern UI effects.
- Expanded guidance on sidebar and header composition, chat UI, and referenced specific component patterns (e.g., collapsible sidebars, auto-resizing inputs).
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.

Initial release of ui-master — a comprehensive skill for building production-grade user interfaces with Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui.

- Guides users through setting up Tailwind v4 (CSS-first) and shadcn/ui for React and Next.js projects.
- Enforces a full design token system (color roles, type scale, spacing, radius, elevation) for consistency and easy theming.
- Prioritizes using shadcn/ui primitives over custom components for real-world maintainability and polish.
- Includes rigorous quality checklist covering accessibility, responsiveness, and real-content robustness.
- Clarifies when to use this skill versus the frontend-design skill, and highlights common pitfalls to avoid.
